title: When I was little
goal: Say when and while with -(y)ken on nouns, adjectives and places: çocukken, öğrenciyken, evdeyken.

intro.text: Add `-(y)ken` to a noun, an adjective or a locative to say **when** or **while**: *çocukken* (when I was a child), *öğrenciyken* (when I was a student), *evdeyken* (while I'm at home). It never changes, and the tense comes from the main verb: *Çocukken çok yaramazdım.*

exercises.question: How do you say **when I was a student**?

why.1: After a vowel, `-ken` needs the buffer y: *öğrenciyken*.
why.3: `-ken` carries no tense; the past goes on the main verb.

exercises.explain: *öğrenci* + y + *-ken*: *öğrenciyken*, for every person and every tense.

exercises.en: When I was a child, I was very shy.

reject.why: Harmony would give *-kan* after u, but `-ken` never changes: *çocukken*.
*Çocuktum* is a full sentence, **I was a child**. To make it the background of the next part, use *çocukken*.

exercises.explain: *çocuk* + *-ken*: **when (I was) a child**. The past is on *utangaçtım*.

exercises.prompt: When I was a child, I was very naughty.

reject.why: *Yaramazım* is **I am** naughty. The past goes on the main word: *yaramazdım*.

accept: When I was in high school, my cousin was at university.
When I was in high school, my cousin was in university.
While I was in high school, my cousin was [at|in] (the) university.
When I was in high school, my cousin was at the university.
My cousin was [at|in] (the) university when I was in high school.

exercises.en: I'll call you while I'm on holiday.

exercises.explain: *evde* ends in a vowel, so y comes before *-ken*: *evdeyken*.

exercises.prompt: When I was young, there was a park here.
exercises.text: Ben gençken burada bir park vardı.

exercises.question: *Hastayken işe gitme.* What does it mean?
options: Don't go to work while you're ill.
Go to work when you're better.
exercises.explain: *hasta* + y + *-ken*: **while ill**; *işe gitme*: **don't go to work**.

exercises.en: When I was at university, I rented a flat in Ankara.
exercises.explain: *üniversitede* + y + *-ken*: the buffer y after a vowel, and *-ken* never changes.

exercises.en: When I was little, I was very shy.

exercises.prompt: When we were children, we were neighbours.

reject.why: *Komşuyuz* is **we are** neighbours. The past goes on the main word: *komşuyduk*.

exercises.prompt: O zamanlar kuzenimle her yaz tatilinde köydeydik.
accept: Back then my cousin and I were in the village every summer holiday.
Back then my cousin and I were in the village every summer vacation.
Back then, my cousin and I stayed in the village every summer [holiday|vacation].
In those days my cousin and I were in the village every summer [holiday|vacation].
Back then I was in the village with my cousin every summer [holiday|vacation].
